ringkasan: Two ESP32 boards connect over the GATT protocol: one acts as the Central, reading a potentiometer, and the other as the Peripheral, driving a servo as soon as it receives a notification.
The delay measured is the one way travel time from Central to Peripheral, compared against the round trip delay the Central prints for itself once the echo comes back.

catatan: GPIO34 is an input only pin and belongs to ADC1, the only ADC that can still be read while the BLE radio is on.
An SG90 servo draws an inrush current the 3V3 regulator cannot supply, so its red wire must be taken from the VIN (5 V) pin with a common ground.
The ESP32-S3 has no ADC on GPIO34, so on that board the potentiometer moves to GPIO4 by enabling #define BOARD_ESP32S3 in the Central program.
